ITEM 1 | Pale golden-brown crispy fried strip, about 6 cm long and 2 cm wide, with a breaded, slightly bumpy surface and a light sheen, sitting on top of the rice mixture near the upper center of the plate | 35
ITEM 2 | Loose fried rice mixed with small brown bits, pale grains with green flecks, and fine golden-brown crumbs, forming a mound about 10 cm across and 2 cm tall in the center of the plate, dry and slightly glossy | 150
ITEM 3 | Shredded pale brown meat pieces, stringy and fibrous with darker browned edges, scattered through and over the rice mound, about 3 cm pieces | 30
ITEM 4 | Cubes of bright yellow fruit, about 1.5 to 2 cm square, firm with a slightly glossy, moist surface, arranged in a cluster along the right edge of the plate | 70
ITEM 5 | Thin curled brown shaving, about 4 cm long, dry and papery, lying at the left edge of the rice mound | 2
ITEM 6 | Small flecks of chopped green herb, scattered in tiny pieces across the rice mound | 2
